title: LTM-RAG: Longitudinal Trust Mining for Poison-Resilient Retrieval-Augmented Generation
venue: IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026)
summary: A longitudinal trust-mining framework for retrieval-augmented generation that remains resilient when retrieved evidence is poisoned.
abstract: LTM-RAG studies how retrieval-augmented systems can identify and manage unreliable evidence over time when the retrieval corpus is subject to poisoning.

title: LLM-INSTRUCT at UZH Shared Task 2026: Constraint-Aware Retrieval and Selective Debate for Paragraph-Level Argument Mining
summary: Constraint-aware retrieval and selective debate for paragraph-level argument mining in UN and UNESCO resolutions.
abstract: Winning system for the UZH Shared Task 2026. Under an 8B open-weight constraint, it combines retrieval with selective multi-agent debate to identify argumentative paragraphs and predict their relations.

title: FaLCon: Facet-Anchored Retrieval with Late Consensus for Sim2Real Text-Based Person Anomaly Search
venue: AI City Challenge, co-located with ECCV 2026
summary: Facet-anchored coarse-to-fine retrieval with Qwen3 reranking and uncertainty-gated late consensus for Sim2Real person anomaly search.
abstract: FaLCon combines global semantic matching, facet-level corrective evidence, Qwen3 reranking, and uncertainty-gated consensus to retrieve real-world pedestrian images from detailed text descriptions.

title: GeoRoute: Geometry-Aware Hybrid Inference for Traffic Future-Frame Prediction
venue: AI City Challenge, co-located with ECCV 2026
summary: A geometry-aware, training-free hybrid inference framework for stable long-horizon traffic future-frame prediction.
abstract: GeoRoute stabilizes static geometry in pretrained video predictions using temporal context, depth-layered rendering, and view-conditioned motion routing.

title: Risk-Controlled Evidence-Regime Verification for Noisy, Updatable RAG Fact Checking: A Benchmark and a Conformal Answer/Fallback/Abstain Protocol
summary: Risk-controlled evidence verification for noisy and updatable RAG using conformal Answer/Fallback/Abstain decisions.

title: CREDENCE: Claim Reduction for Decomposition & Enhanced Credibility - Semantic Metrics and Convergence Analysis
summary: Verified claim decomposition and repair with the Semantic-F1 metric, convergence analysis, and cross-domain evaluation.

title: SCoRe: Smoothed Certified Release for Prompt Repair
authors_html: Phuong Huu Vu Tran, Thuan Mai Duc, Phat T. Tran-Truong, Son Ha Xuan, Xuan-Bach Le
summary: A smoothed certified release approach for prompt repair.

title: RAVEN: Reasoning Across Premise Orders with Executable Verification
authors_html: Phuong Huu Vu Tran1,2, Tinh Pham Phuc Do1, Tai Nguyen Khanh1,3, Hoai Minh Phan1,4, Tran Van Nhiem, Linh Ngo Van5, Son N. Tran6, Ngoc-Thanh Dinh7, Trung Le8
note: Transformers Lab and Dream AI Lab
